harmonizationStatus.method: Source-stratified UTC calendar plus exploratory spatiotemporal associations; no count conversion
harmonizationStatus.reason: Unknown acquisition exposure and detection sensitivity prevent a validated sensor-neutral activity series

temporal.meaning: Source-separated delivered observations; no missing dates are zero-filled

parameters.reference: All prior observed years for the same calendar month and exact source stratum
parameters.unusual: Strictly greater than every eligible reference count
parameters.ties: Competition rank: 1 + number of greater counts; ties are not record-high
parameters.median: Median of counts in prior observed same-calendar-month years in the exact stratum; even samples average the two middle values; minimum support required; not exposure-normalized
parameters.critical: Highest raw delivered monthly counts within each eligible source stratum, not emergency severity

limitations: References contain detections only; selection bias and missing acquisitions remain unknown.
Different exposure, sampling or sensitivity can explain delivered-count differences.
Screening many periods does not establish statistical significance; no multiple-testing or exposure correction is supplied.
No sensor-normalized rate, probability, confirmed event or forecast is supplied.
Standard processing is delivery-declared; NOAA-20/21 lineage remains unresolved.

matchedCalendarMonths.method: Same calendar month and exact dataset/source/sensor/platform/product/version/processing/confidence stratum; observed support only
limitations: Months missing on either side remain unknown, not zero.
Selecting months with detections in both years introduces selection bias.
Equal calendar months do not establish equal sampling, acquisition coverage or sensitivity.
Raw FRP sums are reported MW, not energy or comparable fire intensity.

detectionExtentOverlap.method: Intersection of delivered detection date extents in the same region and processing stage; not verified acquisition overlap

methodology.distance: Haversine great-circle distance, mean Earth radius 6371.0088 km
methodology.time: Absolute UTC acquisition difference; inclusive thresholds
methodology.selection: All qualifying pairs; many-to-many; same region and known processing stage
methodology.index: Unit-sphere Cartesian spatial hash plus UTC time buckets; exact Haversine and UTC final predicates
methodology.grouping: Connected components of candidate edges; transitive links are not event confirmation

fingerprint.reason: Descriptive detections only: observed years do not establish complete annual coverage or a validated recurrence model.

spatial.meaning: Fixed longitude/latitude bins, not fire perimeters, geolocation accuracy or equal-area density

methodology.historicalReference: The historicalMedian gate denotes an unavailable exposure-normalized baseline; conditional descriptive prior-month medians are separate in observedPeriodExploration
methodology.utc: UTC day/month/year; meteorological DJF/MAM/JJA/SON seasons; December assigned to following DJF year
methodology.spatial: Existing verified region membership; descriptive 0.02 degree bins only for eligible standard histories; bins are not equal-area or independent events
methodology.comparison: Raw per-source/platform/version/processing contributions in matched detection-extent windows; no opportunity correction
methodology.normalization: Unavailable: acquisition, valid-pixel/cloud masks and independent calibration are missing
methodology.introduction: First delivered year is a delivery fact, never a satellite introduction or operational availability claim

limitations: Thermal detections and candidate groups are not confirmed fires.
Unknown acquisition coverage cannot establish zero activity or sensor misses.
Confidence schemes and sensor sensitivities are not interchangeable.
Processing-stage agreement is an eligibility screen, not proof of calibrated product equivalence.
NOAA-20/21 archive processing lineage and early-date documentation differences require supplier review.
Missing periods, FRP or opportunities are never replaced with zero.
